boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-cost activities and campus programs with direct evidence of free participation or admission.

cards.title: Browse the Museum Galleries
cards.subtitle: Mahaney Arts Center, 72 Porter Field Road
cards.notes: Meet at the galleries and wander the current exhibitions at your own pace; check the museum page for holiday closures before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided art break in the Mahaney Arts Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Middlebury College Museum of Art is free of charge.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Middlebury College Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Friday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday noon–5 p.m.; closed Mondays and listed College holidays.

cards.title: Listen to the Carillon Concert
cards.subtitle: Middlebury Chapel, 75 Hepburn Road
cards.notes: Bring a lawn chair or blanket and listen from the Chapel grounds; confirm the performer and date on the College event listing.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor bell-tower concert series.
cards.evidence_claim: The Carillon Concert Series at Middlebury Chapel is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The cited listing is for August 21, 2026, 6–7 p.m.; verify future series dates before going.

cards.title: Catch a Hirschfield Film Screening
cards.subtitle: Dana Auditorium, Sunderland Language Center
cards.notes: Pick a monthly screening with friends and arrive for the listed start time; use the series page to confirm the current title and date.
cards.short_summary: A campus film series with public screenings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hirschfield International Film Series is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Hirschfield International Film Series | Middlebury College
cards.access_notes: Held once a month at Dana Auditorium; consult the series page for the current schedule.

cards.title: Join a Yoga Club Class
cards.subtitle: Student-taught classes; schedule varies by semester
cards.notes: Check the club’s current semester schedule, then bring a friend for a student-taught class suited to any experience level.
cards.short_summary: Free, student-taught yoga classes for all levels.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury Yoga Club offers free classes open to all students of all levels.
cards.access_notes: For Middlebury students; the club directs students to its Instagram or Presence documents for the semester schedule.

cards.title: Take a YouPower Spin Class
cards.subtitle: YouPower Spinning Room; schedule varies by semester
cards.notes: Use the current YouPower schedule to choose a 45-minute class and go with a classmate; sessions are designed for varied fitness levels.
cards.short_summary: Student-led cycling classes throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: YouPower offers free 45-minute cycling classes for Middlebury students.
cards.access_notes: For students; the schedule changes each semester based on instructor availability.

cards.title: Borrow Gear for an Outdoor Plan
cards.subtitle: Freeman International Center basement
cards.notes: Choose a simple outing, then check the Gear Room’s opening status and borrow the basic equipment you need through the listed process.
cards.short_summary: Free outdoor-equipment use for the Middlebury community.
cards.evidence_claim: Gear Room equipment use is free to the Middlebury College community.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Freeman International Center basement; the source notes it is closed for 2025–26 and reopens September 14 for 2026–27.

cards.title: Get a Bike Tune-Up Together
cards.subtitle: Middlebury Outdoor Programs Bike Shop
cards.notes: Bring a bike that needs attention and ask the shop mechanics about a repair; coordinate with a friend so both bikes are ready to ride.
cards.short_summary: Free bike-mechanic help for the Middlebury community.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury Outdoor Programs says its Bike Shop mechanics work on community members’ bikes for free.
cards.access_notes: Service is described for the Middlebury community; contact Outdoor Programs to confirm shop availability.

cards.entity_name: Middlebury Outdoor Programs Bike Maintenance Sessions
cards.title: Learn a Bike Repair Skill
cards.subtitle: Middlebury Outdoor Programs Bike Shop
cards.notes: Watch for a maintenance-session topic that matches your bike, then practice the skill alongside other students with the in-house mechanics.
cards.short_summary: Free bike-care instruction through Outdoor Programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury Outdoor Programs bike maintenance sessions are taught by in-house mechanics and are free of charge to the Middlebury community.
cards.access_notes: For the Middlebury community; session topics and dates vary, so confirm a current offering before going.

cards.title: Sign Up for a Mountain Club Trip
cards.subtitle: Trips operate through Middlebury Outdoor Programs
cards.notes: Check the club’s announcements for an upcoming hiking, boating, climbing, or winter outing, then join with a friend and follow trip guidance.
cards.short_summary: Student-organized Vermont outdoor trips at no cost.
cards.evidence_claim: The Middlebury Mountain Club leads hiking, boating, climbing, and winter trips free of cost for Middlebury students.
cards.access_notes: For Middlebury students; trip availability and requirements vary by outing.

cards.title: Borrow Telemark Gear from Free Heelers
cards.subtitle: ADK Bike/Ski Shop; seasonal hours
cards.notes: During the winter operating season, visit an open gear hour with a friend to borrow Telemark equipment and ask the club about lessons or outings.
cards.short_summary: Free Telemark equipment lending through a student ski club.
cards.evidence_claim: Free Heelers loans Telemark skis, boots, climbing skins, poles, and tuning equipment free to Middlebury College community members.
cards.access_notes: For the Middlebury College community; the cited page lists seasonal J-term and spring gear hours, so confirm current times with Free Heelers.
